fields.label: Channel
fields.description: Channel this customer type belongs to.

fields.label: Minimum Expiry Days
fields.description: Batches selected on Pick List / Delivery Note for this customer type must have at least this many days remaining to expiry from the dispatch date. Leave blank to disable the check.

fields.label: Round Up
fields.description: Box auto-fill rounds UP: box = ceil(qty / conversion factor). e.g. factor 12, qty 13 -> 2 boxes. Overridden to decimal when the site's Buyer Master has Box Conversion Exclusion checked.

fields.label: Round Down
fields.description: Box auto-fill rounds DOWN: box = floor(qty / conversion factor). e.g. factor 12, qty 13-23 -> 1 box, 24 -> 2 boxes. Round Up takes precedence if both are ticked.
